column2: A small English farming village at dawn around 1600, timber-framed cottages with grey thatched roofs, low morning mist over green meadows and a slow river, smoke rising from chimneys, a single brown horse pulling a cart along a muddy lane
An old brick and timber manor house with a moat and a great hall in flat green English countryside around 1600, overcast soft morning light, a rider with a horse waiting at the gate on a dirt road
A calm bearded Englishman in his thirties in simple dark clothes reading an old leather book by candlelight at a wooden table in a wood-panelled room around 1600, a few books on a shelf, warm glow
A quiet serious boy of about twelve in early 17th-century English clothes walking alone along a country lane between green fields towards a small stone village church, gentle Sunday morning light

A small group of English villagers in plain early 17th-century clothes, men women and children, sitting on wooden benches in a dim old manor room listening to an elderly preacher with a long white beard, soft window light, peaceful
A quiet tidal creek on the flat Lincolnshire coast at dusk around 1607, a small wooden sailing ship anchored offshore, families with bundles waiting on the marshy bank, calm blue evening light
A busy Amsterdam canal in 1608, tall narrow brick houses with stepped gables, small boats with barrels and bales, people on the quay, a church tower in the background, golden afternoon light
A narrow street in Leiden around 1615 with small brick houses, open doorways showing wooden looms and weavers at work, the large Gothic Pieterskerk church rising behind, soft morning light

A small 17th-century printing workshop, a wooden hand press, an older man and a younger man setting metal type by hand, freshly printed sheets hanging to dry on lines across the room, warm window light
A gentle middle-aged pastor in a black gown and white collar preaching in a simple Dutch house room around 1615, families sitting close together on wooden benches, light through small leaded windows
English and Dutch children around 1618 playing together beside a quiet canal in Leiden, brick houses and a windmill in the background, a mother watching from a doorway, soft afternoon light
A group of English men and women in plain early 17th-century clothes talking seriously around a wooden table by candlelight in a Dutch house in the evening, a map of the Atlantic on the table

A small three-masted wooden ship of about 60 tons moored at a brick quay in a little Dutch harbour town in summer 1620, families with chests and bundles arriving on canal barges, windmills in the distance

A crowd of English families in plain 17th-century clothes kneeling together in prayer on a Dutch harbour quay at dawn, a pastor kneeling among them, a small sailing ship behind, emotional but peaceful
A small wooden sailing ship leaving a Dutch harbour with sails raised, a puff of white smoke from a farewell shot, people on the quay waving, calm river, morning light

The Mayflower, a 17th-century three-masted English merchant ship with a high square stern castle, moored on the river Thames near London in 1620, wooden warehouses and small boats, grey summer morning
A weathered English sea captain about fifty years old with a grey beard in early 17th-century clothes studying a chart in a small wooden ship cabin with stern windows, oil lamp, calm

Two wooden sailing ships, a larger three-masted merchant ship and a smaller one, anchored together in Southampton harbour in summer 1620, small rowing boats ferrying barrels, old town walls on the shore
A small wooden sailing ship tilted on its side on the beach of a pretty Devon harbour, carpenters repairing the hull, green hills and a castle at the harbour mouth, soft light
The harbour of Plymouth in England in September 1620, a three-masted ship at anchor, small boats carrying chests and barrels between ships, rocky headlands, old stone houses along the waterfront
The Mayflower with all sails set leaving Plymouth Sound in September 1620, green Devon hills behind, calm sea, gentle golden light, seen from a distance
English families in plain early 17th-century clothes standing together on the wooden deck of the Mayflower at sea, children holding their parents' hands, ropes and rigging around them, calm blue sea
A short sturdy English soldier with reddish hair and a beard, in a leather coat and a steel breastplate, standing calmly on a ship's deck in 1620, sea behind him
Children in early 17th-century clothes sitting together in the low cramped wooden space between the decks of a ship, lantern light, a mother sewing nearby, calm and cosy
A large gentle mastiff dog and a small spaniel lying on the wooden deck of a 17th-century sailing ship next to coiled ropes and barrels, soft sunlight, calm sea
The long low wooden space between the decks of the Mayflower, beams just above head height, families with chests and bundles, a few lanterns hanging from the beams, warm dim light
Small cabins made of thin wooden boards and hanging blankets along the curved side of a ship's lower deck, a family resting on straw mattresses inside, lantern light, peaceful
The wooden planks and ribs of a large dismantled open boat stored on the lower deck of a 17th-century ship, children sitting on the planks, lantern light
A square of grey daylight and fresh air falling through an open hatch and down a wooden ladder into the dark lower deck of a ship, people looking up, dust in the light beam
The great cabin at the stern of a 17th-century ship, a row of small leaded windows looking out over the sea behind, a wooden table with charts and a candle, soft daylight
A simple meal on a wooden plank on a 17th-century ship: hard ship's biscuits, salted meat, cheese, a pewter tankard of beer, an iron pot, lantern light, still life
An iron firebox filled with sand and glowing coals on a wooden ship deck, a woman in early 17th-century clothes stirring a black iron pot of stew, steam rising, sea in the background
A young sailor in a wool cap turning a large hourglass beside a ship's brass bell on the deck of a 17th-century ship, evening light, calm sea
A 17th-century ship's mate measuring the height of the sun with a wooden cross-staff on the deck of a sailing ship at midday, bright sky, rigging around him
English families in plain clothes singing together from a small book in the dim lower deck of a ship, an older bearded man leading, lantern light, peaceful
The Mayflower sailing on a grey autumn North Atlantic, overcast sky, long rolling swells, sails filled with wind, seen from a distance, moody but calm
A 17th-century three-masted ship with bare masts riding out a storm on the North Atlantic, big grey waves, spray, dark clouds, seen from a safe distance, dramatic but not frightening
Men in early 17th-century clothes and sailors gathered around a large iron screw jack pushing up a cracked wooden beam on the lower deck of a ship, lantern light, focused calm faces
Sailors on the deck of a 17th-century ship pulling on a rope and reaching down with a long boat hook to help a young man in the water beside the hull, grey sea, seen from the deck, hopeful moment
The Mayflower on a calming sea after a storm, clouds breaking, golden evening light shining on the sails, wet bedding hung on the rigging to dry
The bow of a 17th-century sailing ship heading into a pale gold and pink sunset on a calm ocean, sailors coiling ropes on deck, peaceful
Families sleeping under wool blankets on the dim lower deck of a ship, one lantern turned low swinging from a beam, a mastiff dog lying by a ladder, peaceful night
A ship's bell and an hourglass on the moonlit deck of a 17th-century sailing ship at midnight, a sailor in a coat beside them, stars overhead
The Mayflower alone on a vast calm ocean at night, a full moon making a long silver path on the water, sails grey in the moonlight, a lantern glowing at the stern
Dawn over the Atlantic seen from the stern of a 17th-century sailing ship, the sun rising out of the sea behind, children climbing up a ladder onto the deck, fresh morning light
A mother in early 17th-century clothes holding a newborn baby wrapped in linen in the lantern-lit lower deck of a ship, women around her smiling gently, warm and peaceful
The Milky Way and thousands of stars over a dark calm ocean, the silhouette of a 17th-century sailing ship with a single lantern at the stern
Seabirds circling the masts of a 17th-century sailing ship on greenish water, seaweed and driftwood floating by, passengers at the rail looking west, overcast morning
Passengers in early 17th-century clothes crowding the deck of the Mayflower at dawn looking at a long low coast of sandy cliffs and dunes with dark forest behind, joy and relief
The Mayflower sailing near dangerous shoals with white waves breaking over hidden sandbanks off a sandy coast, the ship turning away, late afternoon light, seen from a distance
The Mayflower anchored in a wide calm harbour surrounded by sand dunes and low hills of pine and juniper, November 1620, a whale surfacing in the distance, pale light
Men in early 17th-century clothes gathered around a wooden table in a ship's great cabin, one man signing a document with a quill pen, candlelight and stern windows, serious calm mood
A respected Englishman with a grey beard in a dark doublet and white collar, standing among other men in a ship's cabin, they look at him with trust, candlelight
A wooden longboat with armed English men in helmets landing on a quiet sandy beach in November 1620, the Mayflower anchored behind, dunes and pine woods, grey sky
The Mayflower at anchor at dusk in a calm harbour with pale sand dunes around her, lantern light in her stern windows, first stars, peaceful
English women in early 17th-century clothes washing clothes in iron pots over fires by a pond behind the dunes, linen drying on bushes, children playing on the beach, cold November light
A group of English men in steel helmets and armour with muskets walking over sand dunes and through low woods on Cape Cod in November 1620, grey sky
A large woven basket full of colourful maize cobs, yellow, red and blue, uncovered from the sand on a low hill near the shore, English explorers looking at it in wonder
An old wicker baby cradle with a sleeping newborn in linen, in the lantern-lit lower deck of a 17th-century ship, a mother's hand resting on it, peaceful
A small open sailing boat with English men steering with oars entering a sheltered bay in winter, a small wooded island, snow showers clearing, cold blue light
The Mayflower anchored far out in a shallow bay in December 1620, a wooded hill and a small stream on the shore, small boats rowing in between, winter light
English settlers in early 17th-century clothes cutting trees with axes and building a small timber and thatch house on a winter hillside near a stream, cold breath, overcast
The Mayflower at anchor in a snowy winter harbour, light snow falling, snow on the rigging, a few small houses with smoke on the shore far away, quiet and grey
A quiet snow-covered hill above a small settlement of timber houses at dusk, bare trees, soft blue light, a calm and mournful mood, no people
A row of small timber houses with thatched roofs along a dirt street in early spring, smoke rising from wooden chimneys, snow melting, settlers stepping out into the sunshine

A tall Native American man of the early 17th century with long black hair carrying a bow walking calmly down a dirt street of a small English settlement, settlers watching in surprise, spring morning, respectful portrayal
A Native American man of the Wampanoag in the early 17th century showing English settlers how to catch eels in a shallow stream, spring woods, respectful portrayal, calm

The Wampanoag leader Massasoit, tall and dignified with red face paint and a necklace of white bone beads, meeting an English governor in a simple timber house with a green rug and cushions, 1621, respectful
Settlers in early 17th-century clothes standing on a shore watching the Mayflower sail away out of the harbour in April, spring light, calm sea, seen from behind the people
English settlers and a Native American man planting maize in small mounds of earth with fish in an old field in spring 1621, baskets of silver herring, a stream nearby
A simple quiet wedding in a small timber house in 1621, a man and a woman in plain clothes holding hands before a magistrate, two small boys and a few settlers watching, soft window light
A dirt street of small thatched timber houses with gardens and fences in summer 1621, children carrying water buckets, chickens, a dog in the shade, a hill with a small wooden fort above

An outdoor harvest celebration in autumn 1621, English settlers and Wampanoag people sharing food at long wooden tables and around fires, roasted venison and birds, corn, squash, golden autumn light, respectful portrayal
A small wooden sailing ship entering a harbour in November, settlers in early 17th-century clothes on the shore watching and waving, grey sky, a small thatched settlement on the hill
The inside of a small 1620s timber house: earth floor, whitewashed board walls, a big stone and clay fireplace with an iron pot, a trestle table, wooden chests, a bed, dim window of oiled paper
A woman in early 17th-century clothes pounding corn into meal with a heavy wooden pestle in a mortar made from a hollow log, outside a small thatched house, morning light
A small fenced garden behind a thatched timber house in summer, cabbages, onions, herbs, beans climbing corn stalks and big yellow squashes, warm sunlight
English settlers walking three by three in a quiet procession up a hill to a square wooden fort with cannon on its roof, men carrying muskets, Sunday morning, a blue bay below
A small settlement of thatched timber houses on a hill above a bay at dusk, smoke from chimneys, warm firelight in a few windows, first stars above
The Mayflower moored on the river Thames at Rotherhithe in the evening, an old riverside church tower and wooden houses on the shore, calm water, soft light
An older Englishman with a grey beard writing in a large handwritten book with a quill by candlelight in a simple 17th-century timber house, fire glowing in the hearth
A large grey boulder under a small classical stone portico with columns beside a harbour in Plymouth Massachusetts, calm sea, soft morning light, no people
A full-size replica of the Mayflower moored at a wooden quay in a New England harbour on a sunny day, clear blue sky, calm water
The Mayflower sailing alone on a long gentle grey-blue sea on a quiet autumn evening, soft wind in the sails, a lantern glowing at the stern, peaceful
